messages:
emily: Quick flag : console quota heatmaps are showing split lines for org-42. Looks like two distinct attribution keys.
raj: Any clues which SDKs are involved?
emily: Traces show requests from web-app (TS), mobile (Go-based proxy), and batch-jobs (py). Each emits a slightly different header: `x-rw-attr`, `X-Redwood-Attribution`, and `rwAttr`.
tom: Classic. Different casing + snake/camel + different structure -> split buckets.
katie: Can we do a cheap normalization in API gateway before Console/ingestion? That would stop extra buckets fast.
emily: Edge team reluctant to mutate auth-related headers for audit reasons.
raj: Then plan B: Console should detect equivalent account ids across headers and surface a combined view (viz-only) while preserving raw buckets for billing. Add small badge: "merged view".
tom: Agreed. Also we should push SDK owners to emit canonical header. Who owns TS + py + go SDKs now?
katie: TS -> @sofia (but she's OOO), Raj can take emergency PR. Py -> @devon, Go -> @lee.
raj: I'll open a TS middleware PR to write `X-Redwood-Attribution: acct=org-42;route=web` alongside existing JSON header. Non-breaking.
tom: Py owners should flip default to structured header but keep legacy for 2 weeks. Go proxy should add a lightweight header (no parsing) to mirror canonical shape.
emily: Good. Console change: add metric card "canonical header adoption %" and a telemetry alert if adoption drops after rollout. Also in rollout UX, show dependency graph: which SDKs still sending legacy.
katie: We need tests: synthetic that sends mixed headers and asserts console maps to single visualization. Also add unit tests for parsing edgecases: missing acct, extra semicolons, mixed-case keys.
raj: I'll draft the TS PR tonight: middleware + tests + migration note. Will add env flag REDWOOD_EMIT_CANONICAL=1 default off for canary.
emily: Can we run a 1-hour synthetic canary hitting both shapes to verify we don't double-count tokens?
deploy-bot: scheduled synthetic canary: 2026-04-12T02:30Z, 60m, traffic mix 80% canonical /20% legacy.
tom: Important: don't auto-merge visualization. Console should label merged groups with "heuristic merge" and show underlying raw keys on hover.
raj: got it. I'll include a sample build in PR description and a shim to normalize header casing in TS.
katie: Support playbook: how to check headers (curl example) and how to toggle merged view. Add to release notes.
emily: Action items: Raj (TS PR + synth), Devon (py migration plan), Lee (go header shim), Katie (console metric + merged-viz UX + support blurb). Recheck in 24h.
raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-ts/pull/518 (middleware + tests).
emily: Nice. Follow-up tomorrow morning.
